description: What the Baude main window shows for a brand-new chat, before anything has been written: the header and sidebar as usual, an empty chat column, the composer and the status bar. There is no welcome text, logo or example prompt.

parts.name: header
parts.shows: The title reads "New session". The model picker shows claude's default model (as soon as claude lists its models) and the mode picker shows Auto; the effort picker shows the model's default level; the provider picker is hidden for Claude's models. See HeaderBar.

parts.name: chat area
parts.shows: Blank: nothing is drawn in the transcript and no placeholder text is shown. The column is centred and at most 860 px wide unless Full-width text is on.

parts.name: composer
parts.shows: The empty text box (two lines tall, no placeholder), the + attach button and the grey send button, with the focus in the box when the window opens. See Composer.

parts.name: status bar
parts.shows: No dots; the host "local"; the chat's folder (~/…); cost $0.0000; context shows "— / <window>" with an empty bar. After claude starts, "<N> tools" follows the folder. See StatusBar.

parts.name: sidebar
parts.shows: A new chat is not listed in the sessions sidebar until something is typed or attached (text or an attachment begins it); it is listed from then on, even before the first send. A new chat keeps one shared draft that the next new chat opens with. Starting another new chat with /new, /clear or Ctrl+N comes back to this same blank state.
